docs.main:
Controls whether or not log messages are displayed by Cargo.

Mutually exclusive with `term.verbose` --- they cannot both be `true`. The `--quiet` CLI flag overrides and forces quiet output; `--verbose` overrides and disables it.

Default: `false`. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_QUIET`.

Controls whether or not extra detailed messages are displayed by Cargo.

Mutually exclusive with `term.quiet` --- they cannot both be `true`. The `--verbose` CLI flag overrides and forces verbose output; `--quiet` overrides and disables it.

Default: `false`. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_VERBOSE`.

Controls whether or not colored output is used in the terminal.

- `"auto"` --- automatically detect if color support is available.
- `"always"` --- always display colors.
- `"never"` --- never display colors.

Can be overridden with the `--color` CLI option. Default: `"auto"`. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_COLOR`.

hyperlinks.description:
Whether Cargo uses hyperlinks in terminal output. Auto-detected when unset.

[Cargo documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#termhyperlinks)

docs.main:
Controls whether or not hyperlinks are used in the terminal.

When unset, Cargo auto-detects terminal support --- there is no static default. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_HYPERLINKS`.

unicode.description:
Whether Cargo can render non-ASCII Unicode characters. Auto-detected when unset.

[Cargo documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#termunicode)

docs.main:
Controls whether output can be rendered using non-ASCII Unicode characters.

When unset, Cargo auto-detects terminal support --- there is no static default. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_UNICODE`.

when.description:
Whether Cargo shows a progress bar.

[Cargo documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#termprogresswhen)

docs.main:
Controls whether or not the progress bar is shown in the terminal.

- `"auto"` --- intelligently guess whether to show the progress bar.
- `"always"` --- always show the progress bar.
- `"never"` --- never show the progress bar; `term.progress.width` then has no effect.

Default: `"auto"`. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_PROGRESS_WHEN`.

width.description: Progress width in columns (non-negative). Required when when = "always".

term-integration.description:
Whether Cargo reports progress to the terminal emulator (e.g. taskbar). Auto-detected when unset.

[Cargo documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#termprogressterm-integration)

docs.main:
Reports progress to the terminal emulator for display in places like the taskbar.

When unset, Cargo auto-detects terminal support --- there is no static default. Environment: `CARGO_TERM_PROGRESS_TERM_INTEGRATION`.
